summary: Firy Inc. (formerly Skillz Inc.) filed an 8-K on August 14, 2026, reporting the redemption of $80.0 million of its 10.250% Secured Notes due 2026 at par plus accrued interest. After this redemption, $49.671 million of notes remained outstanding. This is a routine debt repayment event under Item 8.01, not a special situation. No strategic implications, tender offer mechanics, or shareholder impact were disclosed. The filing is purely informational with standard exhibits. What to watch: future redemptions or refinancing of remaining notes.
